title: Les Misérables
wpTitle: Les Miserables The Arena Spectacular Reviews Round-up

ratings.excerpt: The famous adaptation of Victor Hugo’s classic novel marches on … This superb production enables Les Mis to play to vast crowds, but the natural habitat of the show remains the theatre … The first thing to observe about this latest rendering of the story of revolutionary upheaval in 19th-century Paris is that it sits – sometimes uncomfortably – between a concert and a theatre performance. In remaking the show for gargantuan arenas the producers have to reckon with the problem of much of the audience being seated a considerable distance from the stage. They address this issue by the use of three huge screens above the stage. Alfie Boe and Michael Ball in an arena spectacular … Ball and Boe spark off each other as this upscaled staging of the globetrotting blockbuster musical reaches the Ovo Hydro in Glasgow … There aren’t many sung-through musicals that could fill a venue the size of the Glasgow Hydro for one night only, let alone confidently embark on a 16-month arena tour, taking in some 15 countries. … The most obvious challenge faced by a production on this scale is how to reach every part of the stadium... Stars bring the spectacle (Glasgow) … I’ve never witnessed Les Mis in anything like a setting such as this, though. The cavernous space of Glasgow’s OVO Hydro arena would swallow up anything except the most extravagant entertainment, and you’re a long way from a cosy West End theatre. This version of the show is unavoidably vast, and that means that for all but the lucky ones you’ll be a long way from the stage and it’ll feel like you’re miles away from the singers, so there’s a risk that newcomers to the show might find it either incomprehensible or silly, a danger enhanced by the paucity of sets. … So there are problems; perhaps insurmountable ones in a production like this.
